# Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchā (Snp 5.12 (PTS Snp 212))
**ID:** Snp 5.12 (PTS Snp 212)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchā* ("The Questions of the Student Jatukaṇṇī") is a canonical discourse belonging to the *Pārāyanavagga* of the *Suttanipāta* in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral; Hazra 1994; Saddhatissa 2013]. Comprising verses 1096–1100, the sutta is composed in mixed Triṣṭubh and Jagatī metres [Norman 1997-2001]. The inquiry centers on the means to abandon birth and aging [SuttaCentral]. In response, the text advocates subduing greed for sensual pleasures and abandoning all grasping, declaring that nothing whatever should be grasped (*mā te vijjittha kiñcanam*) [Arnold and Bowden; Pande 1974]. Philological analysis by K. R. Norman notes metrical adjustments such as *sahāja* for *sahaja*, as well as commentarial explanations glossing *nettam* as the "eye of omniscience" (*sabbaññutañāṇa*) [Norman 1997-2001]. The text is also cited in modern doctrinal expositions regarding the perfection of renunciation (*nekkhamma*) [Sujin Boriharnwanaket].
Within the Pali Canon, the discourse is commented upon in the *Cūlaniddesa*, specifically in the *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 15) and the *Pucchā* (Cnd 2) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus; Sujin Boriharnwanaket]. Automated alignment by DharmaNexus confirms extensive Pali-internal text reuse with Cnd 15 (22 matching passages, 1,514 characters) and Cnd 2 (5 matching passages, 1,477 characters), along with additional reuse shared with the *Piṅgiyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 20) and the *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 15) [DharmaNexus]. Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus reports any cross-language parallels or alignments in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan literature [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

- Mentioned in (SuttaCentral): Cnd 15 Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa; Cnd 2 Pucchā
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa (Cnd 15) (§0.2–2.5 ↔ §8.6–10.5); Pucchā (Cnd 2) (§0.1–5.5 ↔ §65.0–70.0); Piṅgiyamāṇavapucchāniddesa (Cnd 20) (§2.3–2.5 ↔ §1.4–1.6); Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa (Mnd 15) (§3.5–4.4 ↔ §148.1–148.4)
